select distinct
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(user_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(event_date as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(event_name as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as unique_id,
    user_id,
    event_date,
    event_name
from "active_users"."raw"."user_activities"

-- distinct table by user id and date
with activities as (
    select
       user_id,
       event_date,
       
    string_agg(
        event_name,
        ', '
        order by event_name
        ) as event_names,
       count(*) as number_of_events

    from "active_users"."main"."stg_user_activities"
    group by 1,2

),

with_next_date as (
    select
        *,
        lead(event_date) over (partition by user_id order by event_date) as next_date
    from activities
),

-- find out active period
windowed as (
    select
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(user_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(event_date as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as user_event_date_id,
        *,
        case when next_date is null then 0 else 
        (date_diff('day', event_date::timestamp, next_date::timestamp ))
     end as diff,
        cast(
            case
                when 
        (date_diff('day', event_date::timestamp, next_date::timestamp ))
     <= 28 then next_date
                else 

    (event_date + cast(28 as bigint) * interval 1 day)
            end
        as date) - 1 as active_end_date
   from with_next_date
)

select
    user_event_date_id,
    user_id,
    event_date,
    event_names,
    number_of_events,
    next_date,
    diff,
    active_end_date,

    -- Event type flags for filtering
    case when event_names like '%login%' then true else false end as has_login_event,
    case when event_names like '%export%' then true else false end as has_export_event,
    case when event_names like '%share%' then true else false end as has_share_event

from windowed

with base as (
    select
        user_id,
        min(event_date) as first_event_date,
        max(event_date) as last_event_date,
        max(active_end_date) as last_active_end_date
    from "active_users"."main"."fct_users_activities_date_aggregated"
    group by 1
)

select
    user_id,
    first_event_date,
    last_event_date,
    last_active_end_date,

    
        (date_diff('day', first_event_date::timestamp, cast('2024-06-30' as date)::timestamp ))
     as user_tenure_days,

    cast(date_trunc('month', first_event_date) as date) as cohort_month

from base

-- cross join user and date: every user from their first event to the end of the reporting period
-- (active or inactive), so churn, reactivation and inactive counts are tracked consistently
with dates as (
    select
        dates.date_day,
        users.user_id,
        md5(cast(coalesce(cast(dates.date_day as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(users.user_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as daily_user_id

    from "active_users"."main"."dim_dates" as dates
    cross join "active_users"."main"."dim_users" as users
    where dates.date_day between users.first_event_date and cast('2024-06-30' as date)
)

select
    dates.*,
    active_check.user_id is not null as is_active,
    coalesce(event_data.number_of_events, 0) as number_of_events

from dates
left join "active_users"."main"."fct_users_activities_date_aggregated" as active_check
    on dates.date_day between active_check.event_date and active_check.active_end_date
        and dates.user_id = active_check.user_id
left join "active_users"."main"."fct_users_activities_date_aggregated" as event_data
    on dates.date_day = event_data.event_date
        and dates.user_id = event_data.user_id

with monthly_aggregated as (
    select
        cast(date_trunc('month', date_day) as date) as date_month,
        user_id,
        sum(case when is_active then 1 else 0 end) as active_days_count,
        sum(case when not is_active then 1 else 0 end) as inactive_days_count,
        sum(case when is_active then 1 else 0 end) > 0 as has_active_days,
        sum(case when not is_active then 1 else 0 end) > 0 as has_inactive_days,
        sum(number_of_events) as number_of_events
    from "active_users"."main"."fct_daily_users"
    group by 1,2
),

with_previous_month as (
    select
        *,
        lag(has_active_days) over (partition by user_id order by date_month) as was_active_previous_month
    from monthly_aggregated
),

user_first_month as (
    select
        user_id,
        min(date_month) as first_month
    from monthly_aggregated
    where has_active_days
    group by 1
)

select
    ma.date_month,
    ma.user_id,
    ma.active_days_count,
    ma.inactive_days_count,
    ma.has_active_days,
    ma.has_inactive_days,
    ma.number_of_events,
    ufm.first_month as user_first_month,

    coalesce(wpm.was_active_previous_month, false) as was_active_previous_month,
    case when ufm.first_month = ma.date_month then true else false end as is_new_user,

    -- Transition type logic
    case
        when wpm.was_active_previous_month is null and ma.has_active_days then 'New'
        when wpm.was_active_previous_month and ma.has_active_days then 'Retained'
        when wpm.was_active_previous_month and not ma.has_active_days then 'Churned'
        when not coalesce(wpm.was_active_previous_month, false) and ma.has_active_days then 'Reactivated'
        else 'Inactive'
    end as transition_type,

    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(ma.date_month as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(ma.user_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as monthly_user_id

from monthly_aggregated ma
left join with_previous_month wpm
    on ma.user_id = wpm.user_id
    and ma.date_month = wpm.date_month
left join user_first_month ufm
    on ma.user_id = ufm.user_id

-- fixed denominator: every user in the cohort, whether or not they still have rows that month
with cohort_sizes as (
    select
        cohort_month,
        count(*) as cohort_size
    from "active_users"."main"."dim_users"
    group by 1
),

monthly as (
    select
        du.cohort_month,
        fm.date_month,

        count(distinct case when fm.has_active_days then fm.user_id end) as active_users,

        -- Engagement metrics (users with rows in the month)
        avg(fm.active_days_count) as avg_active_days,
        avg(
            case
                when (fm.active_days_count + fm.inactive_days_count) > 0
                then cast(fm.active_days_count as double) / (fm.active_days_count + fm.inactive_days_count)
                else 0
            end
        ) as avg_engagement_score

    from "active_users"."main"."fct_monthly_users" as fm
    inner join "active_users"."main"."dim_users" as du
        on fm.user_id = du.user_id
    group by 1,2
)

select
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(monthly.cohort_month as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(monthly.date_month as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as cohort_performance_id,
    monthly.cohort_month,
    monthly.date_month,
    
        (date_diff('month', monthly.cohort_month::timestamp, monthly.date_month::timestamp ))
     as months_since_cohort,

    -- Counts
    monthly.active_users,
    cohort_sizes.cohort_size as total_cohort_users,

    monthly.avg_active_days,
    monthly.avg_engagement_score,

    -- Retention rate: active cohort users / full cohort size
    cast(monthly.active_users as double) / nullif(cohort_sizes.cohort_size, 0) as retention_rate

from monthly
inner join cohort_sizes
    on monthly.cohort_month = cohort_sizes.cohort_month
